gloss: wasted effort; futile labor; vain attempt

definitions.gloss: wasted effort; futile labor; fruitless work
definitions.explanation: Effort that produces no result; work done in vain. Emphasizes the pointlessness of the endeavor.

examples.japanese: {説得|せっとく}は{徒労|とろう}に{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The attempt to persuade ended in vain.

examples.japanese: これ{以上|いじょう}{探|さが}しても{徒労|とろう}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think searching any further would be a waste of effort.

examples.japanese: {何時間|なんじかん}もかけて{準備|じゅんび}したが、イベントが{中止|ちゅうし}になり、すべてが{徒労|とろう}に{終|お}わった。
examples.english: I spent hours preparing, but the event was canceled and it was all for nothing.

notes:
USAGE:
{徒労|とろう} is a somewhat formal word used to describe effort that yielded no results. The most common pattern is {徒労|とろう}に{終|お}わる (to end in futility).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徒労|とろう}に{終|お}わる (to end in vain)
- {徒労|とろう}に{帰|き}す (to come to nothing — literary)
- {徒労|とろう}{感|かん} (a sense of wasted effort)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無駄|むだ}: waste (more casual, broader usage)
- {骨折|ほねお}り{損|ぞん}: wasted effort (colloquial expression)
